address_comment_regular: [Verified] On property destruction, this owner drains its +0x80 NiTPointerList<DECAL_DATA*>; each node stores links at +0/+4 and payload at +8. The destructor removes nodes, releases payload smart pointers through DECAL_DATA_ReleaseOwnedReferences, and frees each 0x4C payload. Normal effect teardown instead removes one node through BSShaderLightingProperty_RemoveDecalData before freeing the payload.
